answer.ruling: Choose a clearing with your warriors or pawn and an enemy defender; you need not rule it. Defender may play a matching ambush (birds wild); attacker may foil with a matching ambush. A foiled ambush deals no hits; otherwise defender deals two immediate hits, not capped by warriors, and if no attacking warriors/pawns remain battle ends. Roll: higher die is attacker's hits, lower defender's (equal dice equal); each rolled total is capped by that side's warriors, except Vagabond uses undamaged swords. Resolve before-roll effects then after-roll effects; attacker chooses order when both sides have effects at that timing. Count extra hits uncapped, subtract ignored hits, and attacker gets one defenseless hit if defender has no warriors (Vagabond instead checks for no undamaged swords). For each side taking hits, it chooses removals, but must remove all its warriors before buildings/tokens; it orders its removal effects. Both sides deal counted hits, and losing warriors does not change roll caps retroactively. Each enemy building/token removed scores one VP for its remover, including defender/outside battle; Vagabond takes hits as item damage.
